## Research Experience

::: cv-entry
**Graduate Student Researcher** [2021–2026]{.cv-date}\
University of California, Merced · Advisor: Dr. Erin L. Hestir

- Collected RGB, multispectral, and hyperspectral data in terrestrial and aquatic environments using field spectrometers and UAVs
- Conducted field surveys and analysis of eDNA, soil, water, and plant samples
- Built GIS workflows in ArcGIS and QGIS and developed the OpenRES QGIS plugin
- Developed R, Python, JavaScript, and Bash tools to process large remote sensing datasets, perform statistical modeling, and develop sensor-fusion algorithms
